product.name: Room of Days
product.promise: A warm physical room answers ordinary movement with satisfying clasps that become quietly musical only through use.
owner_quotes: i like when there's a rhythm and it feels melodic.
sounds really great but can you make the clicking melodic variations sound better overall when clicking around?

avoid: a notification jingle on every tap
brittle sparkle, audible room tail, or synthetic sine purity
altering the approved X contact, clasp, or level while testing melody

shared_dna.transient: The complete selected X contact and 8.5 ms clasp remain the loudest causal event.
shared_dna.body: The entire approved 60 ms X body remains, with only a quieter inherited short resonance added after the clasp.
shared_dna.harmonic_field: Audition hypothesis: D-major-pentatonic A4, D5, E5, F-sharp5, and A5; one global eight-step contour, reset after 850 ms quiet.
shared_dna.texture: X's filtered micro-grain and inharmonic body remain unchanged; the meaning resonance uses the reward's correlated-excitation modal language.
shared_dna.space: Ordinary cues stay centered and dry, parked by 60 ms with no room bus or audible reverb tail.
shared_dna.dynamics: The X level stays at its approved +1.5 dB phone lift; resonance is roughly ten decibels quieter, and rapid use suppresses melody after four taps.

mix.rapid_policy: One global clock advances the phrase across controls. Reset after 850 ms quiet. Apply X's 1.0, 0.93, 0.93, 0.885 rapid gains and suppress tonal continuation after the fourth rapid event.
mix.ducking_policy: A completion clears ordinary resonance immediately; a new ordinary onset may steal only the prior resonance tail, never its own X core.
silence_policy: cancel or dismiss without a commit
mix.compound_outcome_rule: An action emits one X-plus-phrase cue or one atomic locked contact-to-completion plan, never both independently.
mix.voice_stealing_rule: Completion steals every ordinary resonance; at the ordinary voice cap the newer X core plays and the older resonance tail fades first.
mix.state_dedupe_rule: State-transition IDs dedupe repeated callbacks independently of the legitimate global phrase clock.
mix.settings_rule: Respect sound disabled, native silent behavior, external audio mixing, and reduced-feedback settings before scheduling.

contact.recipe: Byte-locked complete X source masters from room-c-gesture-v3.

body.recipe: The same complete X source, including its body and explicit 8.5 ms clasp.

space.recipe: No room bus; every ordinary master is mono and parked inside 60 ms.

signature.recipe: Equal-energy 49.5 ms modal/excitation stems derived from the selected reward language and beginning at 10.5 ms.
